title: MT Uikku level-ice model tests (ice basin, scale 1:31.56), resistance at full scale

ship.name: MT Uikku (double-acting icebreaking tanker, Neste/Nemarc)
ship.source: Hu & Zhou (2016) ship particulars (also tabulated by Koto & Afrizal 2017, Table 2)

convention_notes.bow_angle_deg: waterline entrance angle as reported (21 deg); used as the plan-view stem half-angle argument phi/2 in R_break
convention_notes.flare_deg: stem angle 30 deg as reported; used as the plating angle to the horizontal in R_crush (assumption A1)

provenance.citation: Hu, Z. & Zhou, L. (2016) Further study on level ice resistance and channel resistance for an icebreaking vessel, Int. J. Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering 8(2) 169-176
provenance.retrieval_note: Publisher PDF (Elsevier, CC BY-NC-ND) returned HTTP 403 from this worktree's network on 2026-11-10; the digits were ingested from the archived in-ecosystem transcription of the same tables (TensorDEM mt_uikku_level_ice.csv) whose README documents the Table-3/Table-8 discrepancy. Pass A and pass B are two independent read orders/unit paths over that transcript.

sources.role: pass A digitisation of Tables 3/8 (SI-derived units)
pass B digitisation (row-major, MPa/GPa unit path)

limitations: digitised summary forces, not the raw force time series
Table 3 and Table 8 differ by ~1-2% on several cases; the mean-force column is used as truth and the Table 8 reference is carried as an alternative
